reasons: Both answers meet every rubric item with correct arithmetic (131 vs 96 cancellations, ~27% save rate, 996 RUB/month discount cost) and similar deadline-compatible alternatives: a reason survey, reason-specific offers, a limit of one offer per account, and a 50/50 A/B test. B edges ahead because it offers a fallback if the CEO insists on a full rollout (one discount per account plus a 10-20% control group), quantifies the 67% price jump when the discount ends, and turns failed-payment churn into a concrete parallel action. A has a sharper break-even calculation for discount abusers, but its CEO pitch argues against the full rollout less concretely.
